title: Thresholds and Learning in Adaptive Intrusion Detection: A Two-Capture Case Study — code and recorded evidence
description: Code, versioned diagnostic protocols, initial fitted model states, full per-block reports, input manifests and analysis for a two-capture case study of threshold selection and model adaptation under sparse delayed labels. Includes 55 first-extension cells and 120 second-review cells, of which 30 check existing trajectories. Raw network data are not redistributed. Captures were previously inspected; seeds quantify conditional algorithmic variation. Historical Windows measurements and Linux reconstructions are distinct evidence stages.
